_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_experiment: Smoke test for the REPL_MLP gamma sweep on golden_small_incl: gammas {0,64} x {0,16} and plain LRU, top simpoint. Checks gi0_gd0 == lru and that both boosts mark lines at once. Generated by tools/mlp_gamma/make_descriptors.py; analyze with tools/mlp_gamma/report.py.
_workload_manager: manual: run the simulations on this machine, at most max_parallel at a time
_root_dir: Mounted as the container home; output goes to <root_dir>/simulations/<experiment>. On the storage drive, since the root disk holding /home is nearly full.
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: A private clone at matthewpipie/scarab main, so sci's in-place hash checkout cannot disturb a working checkout.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces, resolved as <traces_dir>/<suite>/<subsuite>/<workload>.
_top_simpoint: The 1 highest-weight simpoints of each workload, weights renormalized to sum to 1.
_simulations: All 12 google workloads (shanen's traces, used in place). 10M warmup + 50M measured per simpoint.
_configurations: gi<I>_gd<D>: --mlp_lin_instr_lambda I, --mlp_lin_data_lambda D, on scarab_f1fce3c. Marking uses main's defaults (mlp_instr_mark 2, mlp_instr_starve 2, mlp_lin_data_thresh 0.7).

lru._params: Plain L2 LRU (policy 0), to confirm gi0_gd0 reproduces it.

gi0_gd0._params: REPL_MLP, fill-counted, instruction gamma 0, data gamma 0 (plain LRU).

gi64_gd0._params: REPL_MLP, fill-counted, instruction gamma 64, data gamma 0.

gi0_gd16._params: REPL_MLP, fill-counted, instruction gamma 0, data gamma 16.

gi64_gd16._params: REPL_MLP, fill-counted, instruction gamma 64, data gamma 16.

_visualize: ./sci --visualize shows IPC for the corners; tools/mlp_gamma/report.py covers the whole grid.
